overall_notes: The paper focuses on syntactic generalization evaluation rather than traditional NLG output quality assessment. It uses language model probabilities (surprisal/likelihood comparisons) to evaluate syntactic competence through minimal pairs and grammaticality judgments. Evaluation is automated using perplexity and accuracy metrics on syntactic test suites.
